target: default by horizon using existing complete-horizon labels

cohorts.test_interpretation: previously inspected exploratory cohort, not untouched confirmatory evidence
cohorts.sampling: fixed-seed random sample from loan-ID intersection of all three horizon-mature cohorts

feature_mapping: SHAP encoded-input contributions summed within original feature family; exact transformed names also retained separately

shap.method: TreeExplainer with tree_path_dependent perturbation and raw XGBoost margin output
shap.scale: raw model margin (log-odds), not probability points

clustering.selection: highest silhouette on the validation explanation sample only
clustering.distance: Euclidean distance on unscaled original-feature-family SHAP vectors
clustering.stability: mean pairwise adjusted Rand index across five validation-only initial seeds

limitations: SHAP describes model associations, not causal effects.
Clusters are explanation-pattern groups, not borrower types or treatment recommendations.
Cluster IDs are fit separately per horizon and are not directly comparable across horizons.
Observed evaluation periods have been inspected previously.
